info.title: The platform's dev-only token route (ADR-0061 point 5, ADR-0062)
info.description: The platform excludes POST /dev/token from its contract on purpose (ApiExcludeController in apps/api/src/auth/dev/dev-token.controller.ts). It answers only when AUTH_DEV_MODE is on, and 404 otherwise. This file describes it so the generator can type it; only a debug build's local environment calls it.

post.summary: A token minted by the local platform for a seeded subject (dev-patient, dev-doctor-link). Local only.

userId.description: A subject the platform's seed created.

code.description: The TOTP code, once the subject has enrolled one.
